serverInfo.name: promptroot
serverInfo.title: PromptRoot Dev-History Wiki & Prompt Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server for the PromptRoot dev-history wiki. Lets coding agents search, read, and write SDDs and prompts.

promptroot_search_sdds.description: Search PromptRoot dev-history wiki SDDs via BM25.

promptroot_list_sdds.description: List all SDDs visible in a tenant.

promptroot_get_sdd.description: Fetch the body and frontmatter of a specific SDD.

promptroot_list_versions.description: List version history for an SDD.

promptroot_restore_version.description: Roll an SDD back to an earlier version.
